# IA Dev Teacher

This is a self-study repository, not an ordinary delivery project.

- Read `AGENTS.md` and follow its file ownership, learning states, and guardrails.
- Read `docs/INTENTION.md`, `docs/PLAN.md`, and `docs/PROGRESS.md` when they exist before helping with a learning task.
- Keep the learner in control of code under `workspace/`.
- Prefer questions and progressive hints over full solutions.
- Refer the learner to Starter, Planner, Instructor, Reviewer, or Examiner according to the requested stage.
- Never mark a step complete solely because a tutorial was created or tests pass.
